issues.title: fix(workspace-index): five workspace-index correctness risks
issues.body:
Five workspace-index correctness risks found by audit:

1. count_usages/find_references disagreement.
2. Query methods do not validate generation.
3. symbols/search_index drift.
4. case-insensitive package merging.
5. find_unused_symbols is O(N^2).
